name: @ui8kit/layouts
description: Layouts (ADR-0001, the second layer between the prototypes and the apps): the structure of the apps on the UI8Kit primitives and kit-compose compositions, texts and data through props, checked like the prototypes (rules detectors and the four style groups, 8+4 spacing included, zero baseline). Svelte 5 for now. src/stock: the Stock storefront (header, type bar, quick filters, facet column, applied chips, sort, card grid, asset card, preview frame, pagination); src/theme: the global Theme sheet of the Magazine and Stock (Theme panel, Design system panel, fields, export/import, specimen; state through a ThemeController of @ui8kit/theme-model/controller); src/magazine: the Magazine's structure as it moves out of apps/magazine (taste card, heart, card strip); src/preview: the live render of a block variant or a screen page from its recipe. Source only: the consumer's Vite compiles it.
